t: Pragmatic Tooling: From Dog-Pile to Desert Kite with WET and AI
s: This article outlines a pragmatic methodology for AI development, advocating for an iterative 'WET and Broken' approach. It uses metaphors like 'dog-pile' and 'desert kite' to illustrate how to channel criticism and chaos into robust, broadly applicable AI workflows by redefining operational norms and focusing on functional tooling.
sub: Dog-pile/Desert Kite Methodology: Reframing criticism as structural input for AI workflows.
WET and Broken Development: Embracing iterative, imperfect starts for robust tooling.
Goodhart's Law in AI Metrics: Navigating the manipulation of performance measures.
Tooling as Redefinition: Building broadly applicable workflows beyond single-task AI uses.
